verdict.rationale: Firecrawl clearly supports bulk operations: crawling entire websites, batch scraping thousands of URLs asynchronously, discovering all URLs on a site, and async webhook notifications for job status instead of polling. This is well documented across docs and GitHub with concrete features like 'Scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously' and webhook-based completion callbacks for batch jobs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks of bulk throughput/reliability at scale and no rate-limit/cost details for large batch jobs.
